newsitem.title: INDONESIA: JAKARTA STOCKS DOWN 2.52 PCT ON CENTRAL BANK MOVE.
newsitem.headline: JAKARTA STOCKS DOWN 2.52 PCT ON CENTRAL BANK MOVE.

text.p: Jakarta stocks plunged 2.52 percent in late morning trading on Thursday following an announcement by the central bank that it will no longer announce its daily intervention and conversion bands, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index was down 16.60 points, or 2.52 percent, to 642.00 points by 0355 GMT. There were 125 decliners. There was no gainer, while 22 issues remained unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at 130 billion rupiah.
Analysts said overall sentiment was likely to remain weak in the near term due to the volatile rupiah

"Foreign players are likely to continue reducing their exposure in the market as the rupiah is likely to stay volatile after the central bank abolished the band," Dandossi Matram, an analyst with Bakrie Finance said.
Selected blue chips such as Indosat and Tambang Timah managed to close higher as the companies mostly receive their earnings in dollars, analysts said.
